sloka: व्यादिदेश महावीर्यान् वानरान् वानर Rषभः ।ते वानर गणाः सर्वे समुत्पत्य युयुत्सवः ॥६-४-२२॥।।
transliteration: vyādideśa mahāvīryān vānarān vānara Rṣabhaḥ ।te vānara gaṇāḥ sarve samutpatya yuyutsavaḥ ॥6-4-22॥।।

translations.english: Then all the heroic monkeys who were eager for combat jumped down from the caves, mountain peaks and trees.
